item.title: S&P upgrades Grab to ‘BB’ on improving earnings quality
item.description: S&P Global Ratings has on Wednesday upgraded Grab Holdings to 'BB' from 'BB-' on improving earnings quality with positive outlook.

item.title: Patrick Grove’s ICON1C raises $7.92M from community and collaborators for expansion, acquisitions
item.description: ICON1C, a Singapore-based investment and operating platform focused on building businesses in the global premium experience economy, announced Thursday it has raised S$10 million ($7.92 million) from its stakeholders and members to accelerate its expansion and for acquisitions.

item.title: Mambu expands payments hub into Indonesia, the Philippines, Malaysia and Singapore
item.description: Mambu, a global software as a service (SaaS) cloud banking platform, announced Wednesday the expansion of its Payments Hub solution into a number of territories including Indonesia, the Philippines, Malaysia and Singapore, marking the first time the platform will be available to customers in Asia.

item.title: IFC invests $40M in Malaysia’s Zetrix AI to improve access to digital public infrastructure services
item.description: The World Bank Group, through its private sector arm the International Finance Corporation (IFC), has announced a $40 million equity investment in Zetrix AI Berhad, to improve access to Digital Public Infrastructure (DPI) services in Malaysia and emerging markets in the broader ASEAN region and beyond.

item.title: Digital Realty expands innovation lab network to Singapore, Japan and London to accelerate AI and hybrid cloud implementation
item.description: Digital Realty, the global cloud- and carrier-neutral data center platform, announced Wednesday the expansion of its Digital Realty Innovation Lab (DRIL) into Singapore, Japan and London.

item.title: AI’s impact is bigger than we think
item.description: Every major technological shift throughout history follows the same pattern: many cling to what they know, while a smaller group adapts early and captures the gains. What makes this moment different is speed. The velocity of business is increasing faster than at any point in recent memory.

item.title: TNGlobal extends application deadline for inaugural SE Asia Pavilion at BEYOND Expo 2026 to March 18
item.description: High-potential startups from Southeast Asia now have until March 18, 2026, to apply for a chance to showcase their innovations at BEYOND Expo 2026.

item.title: Ant Digital Technologies strengthens AI infrastructure in Malaysia to boost local customer service capabilities
item.description: ZOLOZ, the flagship artificial intelligence (AI) product of Ant Digital Technologies, has announced the launch of its operations hub in Malaysia, which will upgrade its local service offerings, accelerate response times, and enhance on-the-ground processing capabilities to better serve Malaysian customers.

item.title: StateSquare Capital to acquire controlling stake in Singapore’s Advanced Integrated Manufacturing
item.description: Singapore's private equity firm StateSquare Capital is acquiring a controlling stake in Advanced Integrated Manufacturing Corp. Pte Ltd (AIM), a Singapore-based aerospace and defense electronics manufacturing services (EMS) platform.

item.title: Malaysia’s AirAsia MOVE revenue exceeds $165M in 2025
item.description: AirAsia MOVE, the digital arm of Malaysia-based Capital A, saw its revenue exceeded MYR 641 million ($165 million) in 2025.
